dct_title_s: Populated Places (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data set includes cities, towns, village and other populated places, displayed as points, throughout China. Locations are classified by population level and administrative categories.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, urban and regional planners, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, local and regional demographic analysis, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. These data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on land use and planning and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap, (e.g. for labelling town names on maps), to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
